# Azure Compute — VM & Scale Set Router

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's router skill for Azure virtual machines and Virtual Machine Scale Sets: it classifies your intent and opens the right workflow — VM recommender (which size or VMSS/autoscale setup fits, with pricing comparisons), VM creator (provision bare VMs or scale sets), capacity reservation groups (reserve and guarantee VM capacity), or Essential Machine Management (enrollment and monitoring) — always preferring its own SKU/image/quota checks over generic best-practice lookups. By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: VMs bill by the minute while running — pick cost-effective sizes and stop or deallocate what you don't use; this skill provisions bare VM infrastructure only, not application deployments (that's azure-prepare). Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
